page.overview:
Who is Dirty Village?

Dirty Village is a location in Final Fantasy Legend II. The villagers of this village are more content living here in freedom than living under the rule of Venus.

The party arrives in a small village in the middle of the jungle. Inside, they see Leon who says that he enjoys living here better, but worries about Flora.

On their way to the volcano, the main character tells Leon about Flora getting married to Nils. Leon doesn't take the news well.
